definitions.explanation: A person who works to overthrow a government or social order by revolution. Also used loosely of someone who brings radical change to a field, such as art or business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{革命家|かくめいか}。
{孫文|そんぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{革命家|かくめいか}だ。
examples.english: Sun Yat-sen was a Chinese revolutionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}んだ→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧{革命家|かくめいか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: He is called a revolutionary who brought new ideas into the world of cooking.

notes:
From ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ (revolution) and the suffix 〜⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (a person devoted to something, as in ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧ and ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{若|わか}き→若い：00823_wakai⟧{革命家|かくめいか}: a young revolutionary (literary)
- {革命家|かくめいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧: the life of a revolutionary
- 〜⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{革命家|かくめいか}: a revolutionary in the world of ~

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧: revolution
- ⟦{活動家|かつどうか}→活動家：32738_katsudouka⟧: activist
- {改革者|かいかくしゃ}: reformer (changes a system from within)
